method: Codex authored the finite profiles directly. The existing order/draft verifier checks exact class, faction, metric, quotes, conflicts, categories and known wording defects. No local model, trial rerun or output repair.

51118.text: The guide describes Hateful Strike as physical damage mitigated by armor. Confirm the tank and healing plan using actual gear and assignments; its base damage is not a prediction of any one player's hit.
The cited guide gives a 7 minute Berserk timer. Review the raid's damage plan against that guide limit; the timer alone does not establish a missed personal cooldown.
Before the pull, confirm which tanks and healers have each Hateful Strike duty. The guide describes a primary off-tank with a buffer off-tank; this analysis does not establish your assignment.

The guide places Enrage at 5% health and calls for tank defensive coordination. Confirm the raid's defensive and healing plan for that point; these guide descriptions do not establish a missed personal use.
One guide option has 3 off-tanks healed reactively after their own Hateful Strike; it also warns that this relies on low latency. Confirm the raid's chosen allocation before copying that pattern.

For Hateful Strike tanks, the guide recommends Flasks of the Titans and Stoneshield Potions. If that is your assignment, confirm the consumable plan with the raid; the ranking category alone does not establish your duty or loadout.

51119.text: The cited guide calls for frost resistance across the raid to survive Frost Aura. Confirm the resistance plan before the pull; these excerpts do not set a numerical gear target for your character.

The guide cautions healers against excessive frost-resistance gear because it lowers bonus healing. Agree a healing/resistance balance with the raid; this excerpt gives no numerical target for your gear.
The guide advises spreading during phase one to reduce grouped blizzard exposure. Confirm the raid's positioning plan; these logs do not record positions.
The guide says to move to the ice blocks only after the third Icebolt cast. Confirm the raid's call for this sequence; these logs do not record positions.

The guide describes a knockback of nearby players when Sapphiron takes to the air. Confirm the raid's transition call; this description does not establish who was nearby or whether a player moved correctly.

The guide describes a single-tank encounter, with additional tanks doing damage instead. Confirm your assigned job before copying a tank or damage comparison; a tank ranking category does not prove that this fight assigned you to tank.

51107.text: The guide describes Locust Swarm damaging nearby enemies while the boss moves more slowly, and scarabs appearing from corpses. Confirm the raid's swarm response and add assignments before the pull; these logs do not record positions.

The guide describes Locust Swarm damaging nearby enemies and preventing affected players from attacking or casting. Review the raid's response to that restriction; it does not establish a missed action or an available cast window for you.

The guide describes corpse scarabs appearing from a Crypt Guard or player corpse. Confirm who handles those adds before the pull; this source does not establish which corpses or scarabs appeared in the recorded fight.

51108.text: The guide describes Decimate reducing raid members and zombies to 5% of maximum health. Agree the raid's recovery and add-handling plan before the pull; the guide does not establish an individual player's healing assignment.

The guide describes Mortal Wound as a stacking healing reduction on the main tank. Account for that restriction when discussing tank survival; the ranking category alone does not establish who tanked or which stacks were present.
The guide describes zombies spawning during the encounter. Confirm add assignments with the raid; no target count, successful control or duty follows from the guide alone.

51109.text: The guide describes Gothik becoming invulnerable and the dividing gate closing at the start. Confirm the raid's side assignments before engaging; these logs do not record positions.

The guide ties the rider's Shadow Bolt Volley targeting to Shadow Mark. Keep that mechanic in the raid's add plan; the source alone does not establish which player had the mark or why a recorded hit occurred.

The guide describes the gate opening and Gothik stopping his teleports at 30% health. Confirm the raid's transition call; this is a guide threshold, not an observed phase boundary or a personal damage window.

51110.text: The guide offers two plans for Followers: hold them for the fight or kill them first. Confirm which plan the raid chose before copying another group's target selection.
The guide describes Rain of Fire damaging a selected area. Follow the raid's avoidance plan; these logs do not record positions and this description does not prove who could have avoided an event.

The guide describes holding Worshippers for much of the fight and later sacrificing them. Confirm the add and sacrifice calls with the raid; this does not establish that your class can control an add or that you had that duty.

51111.text: The guide describes Mutating Injection causing physical area damage after its delay. Agree the raid's response plan before the pull; no class capability, successful handling or affected-player list is established by this source alone.
The guide describes poison clouds dealing Nature damage and requiring the main tank to keep moving. Confirm the raid's movement plan; these logs do not record positions.
The guide says party members hit by Slime Spray spawn a Fallout Slime. Confirm add pickup and target calls; the statement is not evidence that any particular player spawned an add.

51112.text: The guide distinguishes a field phase from a platform phase. Confirm the raid's phase calls before the pull; the published cycle is not an observed phase timeline for these logs.

During the platform phase, the guide describes faster eruptions and the raid moving through safe zones. Confirm the route with the raid; these logs do not record positions and no diagram coordinates are inferred here.

The guide describes Decrepit Fever reducing maximum health during the field phase. Coordinate the raid's response in that phase context; this does not establish a personal assignment or a successful response.

51113.text: The guide's Shield Wall description refers to the understudy, not a player's defensive spell. Confirm the controlled-understudy plan before copying those values into a personal cooldown review.
The guide says Disrupting Shout only strikes players within line of sight. Confirm the raid's line-of-sight plan; these logs do not record positions and cannot establish where a player stood.

The guide describes an understudy becoming temporarily immune to charm when Mind Control ends. Coordinate control handoffs with the raid rather than assuming the same understudy can immediately be controlled again.

51114.text: Agree the opening add jobs: the guide puts ranged on Soldiers and Soul Weavers and melee on Abominations. This does not establish the logged fight's starting phase or any player's assignment.

The guide calls for interrupting the single-target Frostbolt and distinguishes it from the instant, uninterruptible room-wide version. Confirm the raid's interrupt rotation; the source does not establish that your class supplied an interrupt or had an opportunity.
The guide describes five Guardians arriving at 40% health. Confirm the raid's add-control and handoff plan; these guide counts do not establish observed spawns, successful control or a personal duty.

51115.text: The guide describes Inevitable Doom as delayed Shadow damage. Confirm the raid's recovery plan before the pull; its description does not establish an individual's resource availability or a missed survival action.
The guide describes a 1 minute shared cooldown on healing spells under Corrupted Mind. Agree healing order and emergency coverage rather than judging this encounter by ordinary healing cadence.
The guide calls for an assigned group order for Spores. Confirm your group's turn before copying a damage window; the guide alone does not establish who received Fungal Bloom.

51116.text: The guide describes players incapacitated in Web Wrap cocoons that can be destroyed from outside. Confirm rescue targets and assigned helpers before the pull; no individual rescue duty is inferred from a ranking category.

The guide describes Web Spray incapacitating the raid for 8 seconds every 40 seconds. Coordinate the raid's survival plan around that guide restriction; it is not an observed cast timeline, an exhaustive immunity list or a missed-use grade.

The guide describes continuing Nature damage while a player is encased. Coordinate healing and rescue coverage with the raid; the source does not establish which player was wrapped or which helper could act.

51117.text: The guide warns that its curse can infect nearby allies if not handled. Agree the raid's response plan; no class capability or personal assignment is established here, and no disputed damage school or tick interval is asserted.
The guide describes a threat wipe when Noth blinks. Review the raid's response to that mechanic rather than assuming a target change establishes a tank or damage player's error.
Confirm the raid's tank and target calls around Blink. Its guide description is not evidence that an individual had threat, a charge ability or an assigned recovery duty.

51120.text: The guide separates caster and melee jobs across Stalagg and Feugen. Confirm your target assignment before copying another player's opener; the category alone does not establish that assignment.
The guide describes positive and negative charges and movement when polarity changes. Confirm the raid's charge groups and movement calls; these logs do not record positions.

The guide says players lose their charge on death and have neither charge after a combat revival. If the raid plans a revival, confirm how it will handle that state; this is not a universal ban on reviving players.

51121.text: The guide places each Horseman's Shield Wall at 50% and 20% health. Coordinate targets and damage windows with the raid; a threshold alone does not establish a missed personal cooldown.

The guide says a defeated Horseman remains as a rooted spirit retaining its abilities. Keep the raid's post-kill handling plan active; this does not establish an observed spirit or any player's position.
The guide gives Marks a 75 second duration. Confirm the raid's rotation and callouts; that duration does not establish who had a Mark, an individual rotation duty or a safe movement route.

limits: Mechanical checks do not approve paraphrases or certify applicability.
Unknown categories are explicit, not evidence no useful action exists.
No new spells, racial exclusions, observed opportunity, player grade or universal assignment.
Proposed before/during/raid mapping is for later integration review; actual order schema remains unchanged.
Existing Hunter guidance must not be duplicated; no production YAML, old order pins or trial scores changed.
Class notes and source completion remain separate; neither boss nor any cell is marked complete.
